info.title: Content Creator
info.jobDescription:
Who we are

 Meyer has been manufacturing cookware since 1972. Today our 11 factories produce more than 120,000 pans a day, 300 days a year, and employ over 3,500 people. Our portfolio of 17 brands — including Hestan, Anolon, Circulon, Farberware, Rachael Ray, KitchenAid, Great Jones, Ruffoni, and Anyday — is distributed in 30 countries, sold in 4,000 retail stores, carried on 90 digital platforms, and supported by 30 e-commerce sites we own and operate ourselves. We created the first flat-bottom wok, the first hard-anodized nonstick cookware, and the first cookware with a titanium nanobond cooking surface. We're headquartered in Vallejo, California, and our mission is to nourish human connection by inspiring joy for every chef.

 The role

Your mission is to turn our products, our team, and our journey into content people come back for: trend-aware short-form video, images, and any other formats that convert viewers into followers and followers into buyers.

 You'll work with our creative leads to strategize, plan, and film. This is a role with real creative ownership — we're hiring you for your eye and your instincts, not to execute someone else's calendar. You'll shape how our brands show up on all social media platforms, driving creativity, performance, and community connection, while helping elevate creative direction across the broader social team.

 You will be on camera. You will hold the camera. You will cut the edit. If that combination sounds like your favorite kind of day, keep reading.

 What you'll do

  • Work with our Video Product Manager for our social channels — what we make, why we make it, and what it's supposed to do
  • Film yourself and others: unboxing videos, product demonstrations, behind-the-scenes, team features, episodic series, memes, everything social
  • Edit your own work in CapCut (desktop) or Premiere.
  • Produce lo-fi graphics and design assets to support posts (Canva, Figma, Photoshop, or similar)
  • Write copy that's fluent in both internet-speak and brand-speak
  • Pitch ideas constantly — including the memes

 What we’re looking for

 Proven success growing a social account, with a portfolio or account examples (required)

  • A strong eye for cookware: you understand what makes a pan look aspirational on camera
  • Self-sufficiency in filming and editing
  • Comfort in front of the camera as an on-screen presence
  • Fluency in short-form trends, hooks, and best practices across Reels and Tiktok
  • You can turn around your own graphics — nothing precious, just fast and on-brand
  • You scroll a lot and it shows — breaking news, cultural shifts, the latest trend, slang, creator drama
  • An improviser's mindset: you meet opportunities and problems as a "yes, and"
  • Strong verbal and written communication — you can sell an idea in a room
  • Genuinely social. You make friends with anyone, because you never know where the next idea comes from
  • Nothing here is ever the same twice
  • Empathy: you can put yourself in the shoes of the person watching, make a smart guess about what they'll enjoy, and not be precious about ideas that don't land
  • Organized enough to juggle multiple brands, channels, and deadlines without dropping details
  • Hybrid role based at our Vallejo, CA headquarters
  • Experience with paid social or working alongside a performance marketing team

 $75,000 to $85,000, DOE

info.title: Import Compliance Manager
info.jobDescription:
JOB SUMMARY:
The Import Compliance Manager is responsible for ensuring the company's import operations comply with U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP) regulations and all applicable trade laws. This role oversees the accurate classification of imported goods under the Harmonized Tariff Schedule (HTS), manages relationships with customs brokers and freight forwarders, and coordinates the end-to-end flow of container shipments from origin to destination, including bonded warehouse operations and duty drawback recovery. The ideal candidate combines deep trade compliance expertise with hands-on experience managing container logistics and import documentation.

JOB DUTIES:

  • Manage the classification of imported products under the Harmonized Tariff Schedule (HTS), ensuring accuracy and consistency across the product catalog.
  • Oversee end-to-end container import operations, including booking, customs clearance, port coordination, and delivery to distribution centers or warehouses.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for customs brokers, freight forwarders, and carriers to resolve clearance delays, documentation discrepancies, and duty disputes.
  • Ensure compliance with CBP regulations, Importer Security Filing (ISF) requirements, and other federal import/export regulations.
  • Maintain and audit import records, entry summaries, and classification rulings to support recordkeeping requirements and prepare for CBP audits.
  • Manage bonded warehouse operations, including inventory control, CBP-mandated recordkeeping, withdrawal entries, and coordination with warehouse operators to ensure compliance with 19 CFR Part 19.
  • Monitor changes in tariff schedules, trade agreements, and duty rates (including Section 301, antidumping/countervailing duties) and assess their impact on the business.
  • Identify and pursue duty savings opportunities, including free trade agreement eligibility, bonded warehouse deferral strategies, duty drawback, and first sale valuation.
  • Administer the company's duty drawback program end-to-end: identify eligible import/export transactions, prepare and file drawback claims, maintain supporting documentation, and manage relationships with drawback service providers or brokers to maximize duty recovery.
  • Partner with procurement, finance, and legal teams to evaluate landed cost impacts of tariff changes and sourcing decisions.
  • Develop and maintain internal compliance policies, standard operating procedures, and training materials for classification and import processes.
  • Manage and mentor import compliance analysts or coordinators, as applicable.
  • Track key performance metrics related to container transit times, customs clearance rates, and compliance audit outcomes.

REQUIREMENTS:

  • Bachelor's degree in International Business, Supply Chain Management, Logistics, or related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in import compliance, customs brokerage, or international trade, with direct experience in HTS classification. Strong working knowledge of CBP regulations, Incoterms, and international shipping documentation (bills of lading, commercial invoices, certificates of origin).
  • Experience managing container shipments and coordinating with ocean carriers, freight forwarders, and customs brokers.
  • Experience with bonded warehouse (Class 3) operations and duty drawback claim preparation and filing.
  • Familiarity with trade compliance software and ERP/TMS systems (e.g., SAP GTS, Oracle GTM, Descartes).
  • Licensed Customs Broker (LCB) credential preferred, not required.
  • Excellent analytical, organizational, and cross-functional communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple shipments and deadlines in a fast-paced environment. 

$90,000 to $120,000, DOE

info.title: Hospitality Account Manager
info.jobDescription:
Role Summary

The Account Executive, Commercial Hospitality Sales for Hestan Culinary is responsible for driving new business and growing Hestan’s presence in the professional hospitality market — including fine dining restaurants, hotels and resorts, country clubs, culinary schools, and private clubs. This role owns the full sales cycle from prospecting through close, builds strategic chef and operator relationships, and develops targeted campaigns and programs to place Hestan products in the most celebrated kitchens in the world. The Account Executive partners with marketing, distribution, and channel partners to deliver consistent revenue growth and elevate the Hestan brand within the commercial hospitality segment.

Key Responsibilities

New Business Development

  • Prospect and develop a pipeline of qualified opportunities across fine dining restaurants, hotel F&B, resort kitchens, country clubs, and independent culinary operators.
  • Execute the full sales cycle: outreach, discovery, live demonstrations, proposal, negotiation, and close.
  • Leverage industry events (NRA Show, StarChefs Congress, James Beard Foundation events, regional culinary showcases) to generate leads and build brand visibility.
  • Meet and exceed quarterly new logo and revenue targets within your assigned territory.

Campaign & Program Development

  • Design and execute targeted placement programs for priority account segments (e.g., Forbes Five-Star properties, Michelin-star restaurants, top culinary programs).
  • Collaborate with Marketing to develop account-specific materials, ROI tools, demo kits, and hospitality-focused content that moves prospects through the funnel.
  • Build seasonal and segment-specific outreach campaigns that align Hestan’s product launches and promotions with kitchen procurement cycles.

Chef & Brand Partnerships

  • Identify, pitch, and manage partnerships with influential chefs, culinary directors, and hospitality groups to serve as Hestan brand advocates and reference accounts.
  • Coordinate with Marketing and Product teams to support chef partnership activations, media opportunities, and co-branded content.
  • Represent Hestan at culinary competitions, industry panels, cooking demonstrations, and media events.

Channel & Distribution Management

  • Work alongside authorized dealers and foodservice equipment distributors to co-sell, support quotations, and ensure seamless specification-to-close on complex projects.
  • Train and enable distributor rep teams on Hestan’s commercial hospitality product line, competitive differentiation, and sales positioning.
  • Manage the full pipeline in CRM (HubSpot or Salesforce), maintaining accurate forecasts, stage progression, and activity logs.

Account Growth & Retention

  • Serve as the primary relationship owner for a portfolio of existing hospitality accounts, identifying expansion opportunities across product categories and locations.
  • Partner with Customer Success and Service teams to resolve issues proactively and ensure long-term customer satisfaction.
  • Conduct regular business reviews with key accounts to surface new opportunities and deepen strategic relationships.

Qualifications

Required

  • 5+ years of B2B sales experience, with a strong preference for foodservice equipment, luxury hospitality, culinary product sales, or related industries.
  • Demonstrated track record of meeting or exceeding quota in a territory-based, field sales role.
  • Existing relationships within the professional culinary or hospitality community (chefs, F&B directors, purchasing managers, hotel operators, club managers, or culinary school administrators).
  • Strong business acumen and ability to build ROI-based value propositions tied to kitchen performance, durability, and total cost of ownership.
  • Comfort with complex, multi-stakeholder sales processes involving end users, specifiers, purchasing departments, and channel partners.
  • Proficiency with CRM platforms and standard sales tools; data-driven approach to pipeline management.
  • Willingness and ability to travel up to 60% within the territory.

Preferred

  • Experience selling premium or luxury goods to high-standards buyers in the hospitality or restaurant industry.
  • Background in or deep passion for professional cooking, culinary arts, or the restaurant industry.
  • Experience managing and enabling dealer or distribution channel partners.
  • Familiarity with the commercial kitchen design and specification process (architects, designers, consultants).
  • Active presence in foodservice trade organizations or culinary industry associations.

$70,000 to $95,000, DOE + Commissions

info.title: Sr. Manager Demand & Supply Planning
info.jobDescription:
Job Summary

We’re looking for a Senior Manager, Demand & Supply Planning to lead the integrated planning function for a high growth business division, Hestan Culinary. This role owns both demand forecasting and supply planning, ensuring alignment between commercial plans and operational execution.

You will drive forecast accuracy, inventory optimization, and service levels by connecting Sales, Marketing, Supply Chain, and Finance. This role also leads the S&OP/IBP process, builds scalable planning capabilities, and manages a growing team.

 

Key Responsibilities

Demand Planning & Forecasting

  • Own the end-to-end demand forecasting process across all channels (eCommerce, retail, wholesale)

  • Develop and maintain short- and long-term forecasts using historical data, trends, and market insights

  • Lead a continuous improvement program for forecast accuracy, including root cause analysis, bias tracking, and corrective actions

  • Define and track KPIs such as forecast accuracy, bias, and forecast value add

 

Supply Planning & Inventory Management

  • Own supply planning to ensure product availability while optimizing inventory levels

  • Translate demand forecasts into supply plans, including production, purchasing, and replenishment strategies

  • Partner with manufacturing and suppliers to align capacity, lead times, and constraints

  • Manage inventory health, including excess, obsolescence, and stockout risk

  • Define inventory targets (safety stock, reorder points) and optimize working capital

 

Integrated Business Planning (S&OP / IBP)

  • Lead the monthly S&OP/IBP process, ensuring alignment between demand, supply, and financial plans

  • Facilitate cross-functional decision-making and trade-off discussions (service vs. cost vs. inventory)

  • Provide scenario planning and recommendations to executive leadership

 

Demand Generation & Commercial Alignment

  • Partner with Marketing and Sales to incorporate promotions, product launches, and campaigns into forecasts

  • Ensure demand plans reflect commercial strategy and revenue targets

  • Improve visibility and accountability around demand-driving activities

 

Tools, Systems & Capability Building

  • Own and optimize planning tools (ERP, demand planning, supply planning, BI platforms)

  • Identify and implement new tools, automation, and advanced analytics capabilities

  • Build scalable processes and improve data quality and governance

 

Performance Monitoring & Continuous Improvement

  • Track and report KPIs across demand and supply (forecast accuracy, service levels, inventory turns, fill rate)

  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives across planning processes

  • Identify risks and opportunities and proactively adjust plans



Qualifications

  • 8–12+ years of experience in demand planning, supply planning, or integrated business planning

  • Experience in consumer goods, retail, or eCommerce (durable goods like cookware preferred)

  • Proven track record leading S&OP/IBP processes

  • Strong understanding of both forecasting and supply/inventory planning

  • Experience with planning systems (e.g., SAP IBP, Oracle, Anaplan, NetSuite, or similar)

  • Demonstrated experience managing and developing teams

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills

 

Working Conditions

 

  • Environment: Remote. If in the office, work is performed primarily indoors under artificial lighting. You will have close contact with all company employees and customers.

  • Equipment: The role requires consistent use of standard office equipment, including a computer, laptop, telephone, and printer. You will also be around other work equipment and machinery.

  • Physical Demands: This position requires sitting, repetitive use of hands, walking, standing, and reaching overhead. You must also be able to lift up to 40 lbs.

  • Hours & Travel: The standard workweek is Monday through Friday, though some overtime and weekend work may be required. The position is remote w/ some travel to our Vallejo, CA campus.

$120,000 to $150,000, DOE

info.title: Automated Systems & Facilities Manager
info.jobDescription:
Job Summary:

As an Automated Systems & Facilities Manager, you will be responsible for overseeing, coaching, training, and monitoring the performance of our Automation staff across various shifts. Your key responsibilities include managing Preventative Maintenance (PM) and Unscheduled Maintenance for all Automated Systems in the Distribution Center, encompassing ASRS, STV, AGV, Shoe Sorter and conveyor systems. Additionally, you will be tasked with maintaining an organized inventory of spare parts in the workshop.


Collaborating closely with the Manager, you will play a vital role in budget submissions. Your role extends to coordinating and evaluating vendor support activities related to all Material Handling Equipment (MHE) and Automation equipment. You will work in tandem with external contractors on repairs to MHE, ensuring efficient and effective resolutions.


Furthermore, you will maintain accountabilities for all MHE and Scanning equipment within the warehouse, overseeing repairs through contractors and ensuring seamless operations. Your role as an Automated Systems & Facilities Manager is integral to the overall performance and reliability of our
distribution center's automated systems.


In addition to your automation responsibilities, you will oversee the facilities and utilities operations of the distribution center. This includes managing building infrastructure systems such as HVAC, plumbing, electrical, and lighting. Monitoring utility consumption (electricity, gas, and water) to drive cost efficiencies. You will ensure the facility remains compliant with applicable building codes and safety regulations, coordinate capital improvement and renovation projects with external contractors, and maintain a safe, well-functioning environment that supports the broader distribution center operations.

Essential Job Duties:

  • Schedule and coordinate all Preventative Maintenance (PM) activities promptly for equipment under the purview of the Automation Department. 
  • Oversee the hiring, training, coaching, and timely performance management of staff. 
  • Ensure that all personnel working with Automated Systems are trained in the current Safety Standards applicable to equipment in the Distribution Center. 
  • Conduct regular Lockout Tagout Audits on all Automation Maintenance Personnel. 
  • Identify and conduct training sessions for Material Handling Equipment (MHE), Automated Storage Retrieval System (ASRS), and Automation equipment. 
  • Ensure that all maintenance requests are accurately updated in the Maintenance software to validate the hours spent on repairs. 
  • Troubleshoot motor control, variable frequency drives, and soft-starts up to 480 Volts. 
  • Maintain position feedback devices, encoders, load cells, hydraulic systems, and control systems. 
  • Regularly update the database with issues encountered during PMs and unscheduled maintenance requests from the Distribution Center. 
  • Recommend solutions for enhancing the performance of MHE and automation equipment. 
  • Manage inventory and prepare quarterly reports on the usage of spare parts; take action to requisition new spares to maintain appropriate inventory levels. 
  • Ensure compliance with all safety requirements in the workplace. 
  • Lead regular safety meetings and toolbox talks to reinforce safe work practices and communicate updates to safety policies and procedures.
  • Investigate workplace incidents, near-misses, and unsafe conditions; document findings and implement corrective actions to prevent recurrence.
  • Enforce proper use of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) by all personnel operating within the Distribution Center.
  • Conduct periodic safety risk assessments for automation and facilities operations, identifying hazards and recommending mitigating controls.
  • Generate reports on CMMS Software to evaluate repair trends and make recommendations to management. 
  • Provide weekly status reports for all systems maintained in the Distribution Center. 
  • Ensure the proper maintenance and shipping to/receiving from contractor repair for all Computer Scanning equipment. 
  • Develop and maintain troubleshooting guides for all ASRS and Automation equipment. 
  • Authorize purchase orders for work to be done and parts to be ordered.
  • Oversee the maintenance and operation of building systems — including HVAC, plumbing, electrical, and lighting — to ensure a safe and functional work environment.
  • Monitor utility consumption (electricity, gas, and water) and implement cost-reduction initiatives to lower operational expenses.
  • Coordinate with external contractors and vendors for facility repairs, renovations, and capital improvement projects, ensuring work is completed on time and within budget.
  • Conduct regular facility inspections to identify maintenance needs and confirm compliance with building codes, safety regulations, and company standards.
  • Manage facility-related work orders, ensuring timely completion and accurate documentation in the maintenance management system. 
  • Perform any other related duties as assigned by the VP of Distribution & Facilities.

    Minimum Qualifications:

    • Completion of a Mechanical or Electrical Education program or an associate degree in mechanical or electrical technology is preferred. 
    • Proficiency in the use of Autodesk and Computer Aided Drafting (CAD) programs, along with a solid understanding of technical drawings, is required. 
    • A minimum of 5 years of manager experience, demonstrating the ability to coach and train staff effectively. 
    • 3 to 5 years of hands-on experience in Photo Eye, PLC, Pneumatic controls, Motor Controller panels, controllers, and Automation technician functions. Additional functional experience in areas such as Battery Operations, Forklift Operations, Maintenance Inventory Control, etc., is preferred. 
    • 1 to 2 years of direct experience with automated Material Handling Equipment (MHE) and Robotic Arms. 
    • Knowledge and experience with Variable Speed Frequency Drives (VFD) are essential. 
    • Effective collaboration skills with all levels of Meyer staff, vendors, and external contacts are a must. 
    • Proficient verbal and written communication skills in English. 
    • Computer proficiency with a requirement for MS Office knowledge. 
    • Excellent organizational, administrative, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills.

    • Previous experience as an automation & facilities manager is highly advantageous.
